# Attack-like code fragments used by the tests, one per line as `name: text` (text runs to the end
# of the line, kept verbatim). They live here, not in Python source, because this repository's own
# PR scan reads source files: dropper-looking string literals in a test file are, to the scanner,
# dropper-looking code, and would block our own pull requests. Load them with tests.snippets.snippet.
